g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Alarm 清除、幂等、消息分叉与 Edge 传播
asynchronous callback may run before or after REST side effects
so it does not emit EntityActionTrigger.
The Edge ActionEntityEvent was published in BaseAlarmService
The alarm row, comments, audit, WebSocket, notification,
Rule Engine messages and Edge events do not share one transaction.
The database is already committed before root action enqueue.
A producer failure cannot restore the active Alarm.
[no create rule TRUE and currentAlarm + clear rule exist]
External root clear updates Device Profile state
This Edge branch bypasses DefaultAlarmSubscriptionService and
EntityActionService: no local WS, AlarmTrigger or root ALARM_CLEAR.
Concurrent duplicate clear and ACK comparison
